title: Every unconfined Steiner triple system carries an orientation
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled proposition at source lines 445-446, that the unconfined Steiner triple systems form a subclass of the oriented ones. The author gave it no label, so its position is part of its identity. The proof (source lines 447-451) runs two separate inductions on the cardinality: the first produces an orientation by removing an element that lies in at most one block, the second establishes the density condition for subsets of size at most two by passing to a larger subset and comparing densities. The statement records the inclusion only, and neither the case split of the first induction nor the density comparison of the second appears in it.

primary.label: unlabelled proposition at source lines 445-446 (the inclusion of the unconfined systems in the oriented ones)

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the unlabelled proposition, retained line for line
